__note: jaspy-nexus internal performance dashboard. Import via Grafana: Dashboards -> New -> Import -> Upload JSON, then pick your Prometheus data source. Two scrape sources feed this dashboard, both from the same nexus host:port (so they share the same 'instance' label): (1) the lock-free perf counters at GET /dev/metrics/perf (jaspy_perf_* series) for the poll-loop / SNMP-backend / IMDS panels, and (2) the per-device/query SNMP poll counters at GET /dev/metrics (jaspy_poll_snmp_* series) for the 'SNMP poll load' section. Add a Prometheus scrape config for EACH path (metrics_path: /dev/metrics/perf and metrics_path: /dev/metrics); the 'SNMP poll load' panels stay empty until /dev/metrics is scraped.
title: jaspy-nexus — internal performance

panels.title: Poll rate
panels.description: Completed responsive per-device poll iterations per second. Steady state ≈ monitored devices ÷ JASPY_POLL_LOOP_MSECS/1000.

panels.title: Overrun ratio
panels.description: Share of poll iterations that exceeded the cycle budget (JASPY_POLL_LOOP_MSECS). Sustained > a few % means the fleet is not keeping up.

panels.title: Mean poll iteration
panels.description: Average wall time of one responsive per-device poll (all SNMP tables + IMDS report). Budget is JASPY_POLL_LOOP_MSECS (default 10 000 ms).

panels.title: Peak poll iteration
panels.description: Slowest single poll iteration since process start (lifetime high-water mark, never resets). Watch for step-ups.

panels.title: Mean SNMP query
panels.description: Average time per SNMP table/object request that got a reply or real error (timeouts excluded).

panels.title: SNMP error ratio
panels.description: Share of SNMP requests returning a genuine (non-timeout) error — e.g. 'Too many open files' under FD pressure.

panels.title: SNMP in-flight (now)
panels.description: SNMP requests currently in the back end. Capped by snmp_max_inflight when set (0 = unlimited).

panels.title: Session opens/s
panels.description: Embedded SNMP session (UDP socket) opens per second — the file-descriptor pressure canary in embedded mode. Should track the query rate and plateau, not grow unbounded.

panels.title: Poll & overrun rate
panels.description: Responsive polls/s vs. overrunning polls/s (iterations exceeding the cycle budget).

panels.title: Poll iteration time — mean & peak
panels.description: Mean per-iteration wall time (windowed) and the lifetime peak high-water mark. Dashed line marks a 10 s budget reference.

panels.title: Overrun ratio
panels.description: Overrunning polls as a percentage of all responsive polls.

panels.title: Interfaces reported/s
panels.description: Interface rows written into the in-memory data store per second — effective useful poll throughput.

panels.title: SNMP query rate
panels.description: SNMP table/object requests per second that got a reply or a real error (timeouts counted separately).

panels.title: SNMP query time — mean & peak
panels.description: Windowed mean SNMP request time and the lifetime peak high-water mark (never resets).

panels.title: SNMP errors & timeouts/s
panels.description: Genuine (non-timeout) errors vs. device-not-responding timeouts, per second.

panels.title: Session opens/s (FD pressure)
panels.description: Embedded SNMP UDP-socket opens per second. In embedded mode each session opens a socket; if this climbs toward the process file-descriptor limit you get 'Too many open files' and dropped polls. Should plateau, not grow unbounded.

panels.title: SNMP in-flight — current & peak
panels.description: Concurrent SNMP requests in the back end: live gauge plus the lifetime peak high-water mark. Peak near a round number suggests snmp_max_inflight is capping.

panels.title: In-flight limiter wait
panels.description: Back-pressure from the snmp_max_inflight cap: acquisitions/s and mean time blocked waiting for a permit. Near zero unless the cap is the bottleneck (and always zero when snmp_max_inflight=0/unlimited).

panels.title: IMDS lock wait — mean & peak
panels.description: Time a poller blocks acquiring the global IMDS lock: mean per poll (windowed) and lifetime peak. The key single-global-mutex contention signal (PERF.md #2).

panels.title: IMDS report time (mean/poll)
panels.description: Mean time holding the IMDS lock in report_interfaces per poll. Should stay small; growth here directly serializes pollers.

panels.title: Metrics scrape cost
panels.description: Prometheus scrapes/s of /dev/metrics and the mean time spent building the metric list under the IMDS lock (plus lifetime peak).

panels.title: Slow & dead devices
panels.description: Devices whose adaptive SNMP timeout is elevated above the floor, and devices collapsed to fast-fail (unresponsive at the max timeout).

panels.title: Max effective SNMP timeout
panels.description: Largest adaptive per-device SNMP timeout across the fleet — how far the slowest switch has pushed its learned timeout above the floor.

panels.title: SNMP poll load — per device & query
Fleet SNMP requests/s
panels.description: Total SNMP table/object requests issued per second across all devices and collectors. Per-device/query SNMP poll counters from /dev/metrics (jaspy_poll_snmp_*), recorded at the SnmpSource seam so every collector is covered.

panels.title: Fleet metrics polled/s
panels.description: Total SNMP metric data points (values) fetched per second across the fleet. Per-device/query SNMP poll counters from /dev/metrics (jaspy_poll_snmp_*), recorded at the SnmpSource seam so every collector is covered.

panels.title: Fleet SNMP errors/s
panels.description: Genuine (non-timeout) SNMP errors per second across the fleet.

panels.title: Fleet SNMP timeouts/s
panels.description: SNMP requests per second where the device did not respond within the timeout.

panels.title: Top devices — SNMP requests/s
panels.description: The 10 devices issuing the most SNMP requests/s. High values flag devices worth polling more cheaply (e.g. the per-VLAN STP fan-out). Per-device/query SNMP poll counters from /dev/metrics (jaspy_poll_snmp_*), recorded at the SnmpSource seam so every collector is covered.

panels.title: Top devices — metrics polled/s
panels.description: The 10 devices producing the most metric values/s.

panels.title: Heaviest query types — requests/s
panels.description: The 15 SNMP tables/objects (query id) costing the most requests/s fleet-wide — the primary signal for what to poll less often.

panels.title: Heaviest query types — metrics/s
panels.description: The 15 query types producing the most metric values/s fleet-wide.

panels.title: Mean query time by type
panels.description: Mean wall time per request for each query type (rate(nanos)/rate(requests), timeouts excluded). Slow query types are prime optimisation targets.

panels.title: Values per request by query (bulk efficiency)
panels.description: Metric values returned per request for each query type. Low values = many requests for little data (candidates to batch, cache, or poll less often).

panels.title: Top devices — SNMP errors/s
panels.description: The 10 devices with the most genuine (non-timeout) SNMP errors/s.

panels.title: Top devices — SNMP timeouts/s
panels.description: The 10 devices with the most SNMP timeouts/s (unresponsive / slow devices).
